name: Co-57
notes: Electron capture to Fe-57. Low-energy doublet (alternative de-excitation paths, modelled mutually exclusive per decay). THE gamma-camera flood-uniformity source. Does NOT transmute to Co-60 -- but aged Co-57 flood sheets show growing Co-60 because Co-57 (272 d) decays ~7x faster than the trace Co-60 (5.27 y) impurity.
